question: From the H&E pathology images alone, how much of the PAM50 subtype information can be predicted?
estimand: Patient-level out-of-fold macro-F1 and paired gain over chance (plus proportion of class-prior deviance explained) for predicting four-class PAM50 subtype from H&E image features alone.
target: Four-class PAM50 intrinsic breast cancer subtype (LumA, LumB, Basal, Her2) per labelled patient.
allowed_inputs: Patient-mean H&E foundation-model feature vectors (UNI2-h, CONCH-Z, Virchow2, MUSK, H-Optimus-1)
Tile-level H&E foundation-model feature vectors (up to 128 tiles per slide across the five encoders)
Patient and slide identifiers for patient-level aggregation and split grouping
Collection site identifier solely for defining site-held-out cross-validation splits (never as a predictor)
Unlabelled patients' H&E image features solely for fold-internal unsupervised representation fitting if used (never scored)

forbidden_reasons.er, pr, her2 (immunohistochemistry recep: Receptor statuses are separate clinical measurements correlated with PAM50; including them creates a non-image clinical shortcut and invalidates H&E-only predictability.
forbidden_reasons.histological_type: Recorded histological type is a curated clinical-pathological variable rather than raw H&E image features, violating the restriction to H&E images alone.
forbidden_reasons.age and stage: Patient age and tumour stage are non-image clinical variables; using them estimates multimodal prediction rather than information present in H&E images alone.
forbidden_reasons.RNA expression or RNA-derived variables: PAM50 subtypes are defined directly from tumour RNA expression, so any RNA-derived feature leaks the target construction and invalidates image-based prediction.
forbidden_reasons.site (as a model input feature): Collection site is non-image institutional metadata associated with PAM50 class (Cramer's V = 0.21); using it as a predictor exploits technical confounding.

required_comparators: Majority-class null classifier fit on training folds (guards against majority-subtype collapse under class imbalance)
Stratified class-prior null baseline fit on training folds (zero-information ruler for macro-F1, AUROC, and log-loss entropy)
Simple image-only reference: class-weighted regularised multinomial logistic regression on single-encoder patient-mean H&E features
primary_metric: Out-of-fold four-class macro-F1 (and paired macro-F1 difference above chance floors) across repeated nested patient-level cross-validation with 95% patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals
secondary_metrics: Proportion of class-prior multi-class log-loss (Shannon entropy) explained out-of-fold with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Macro and per-class one-vs-rest AUROC with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Per-class recall, precision, and F1 across LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 (highlighting minority Her2 and LumA-versus-LumB separation)
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference versus the simple patient-mean logistic regression reference with 95% bootstrap CI
Site-held-out grouped cross-validation macro-F1 and paired gain over chance (19 collection sites) with 95% bootstrap CI

acceptance_criteria.statement: Predictors use only H&E image features; clinical, immunohistochemistry receptor, RNA-derived, and site variables are excluded from model inputs.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Pass requires zero forbidden variables in any model input or preprocessing step; site is permitted only to define held-out validation splits.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All slides and tiles of each patient stay on the same side of every split and bootstrap resample.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Group all slide and tile records by patient ID so train and evaluation patient sets have zero overlap in every fold.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Encoder choice, tile-versus-mean level, dimensionality reduction, class weights, and hyperparameters are selected strictly within inner training folds.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Select the configuration maximising inner-fold macro-F1 without accessing outer-fold patient features or labels across repeated nested cross-validation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Out-of-fold H&E macro-F1 exceeds data-derived majority-class and training-prior chance baselines on the labelled cohort.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Floor thresholds are derived directly as out-of-fold macro-F1 of majority-class and stratified class-prior predictors fit on identical training folds.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Any complex tile-level or multi-encoder method is benchmarked directly against simple patient-mean class-weighted regularised logistic regression.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Reference score is out-of-fold macro-F1 of inner-tuned regularised multinomial logistic regression on patient-mean H&E features on identical splits.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Iterative or neural H&E classifiers demonstrate stabilised training loss or inner validation metric before termination.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Convergence is verified when solver tolerance is met or trailing-epoch loss slope stops improving relative to earlier training epochs inside folds.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All compared H&E models and null baselines are scored on the exact same labelled patients and fold assignments.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Require identical labelled patient IDs, identical outer fold indices, and identical exclusion of unlabelled patients from scoring across all arms.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Primary macro-F1 and paired differences against comparators are reported with 95% patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Resample labelled patients with replacement across aggregated repeated outer-fold predictions to derive percentile 95% confidence bounds.

conclusion_options: Broad predictability: H&E macro-F1 beats chance (95% CI) in both patient and site-held-out CV, with all four classes beating chance; report macro-F1 and entropy-explained 95% intervals.
Partial predictability: H&E macro-F1 beats chance (95% CI) in both patient and site-held-out CV, but at least one PAM50 class fails to beat chance at 95% confidence.
Site-confounded predictability: H&E macro-F1 beats chance (95% CI) in patient-level CV, but its paired 95% interval over chance in site-held-out CV includes or falls below zero.
Insufficient evidence of predictability: the paired 95% confidence interval for H&E-only macro-F1 over the chance floor in patient-level nested CV includes or falls below zero.
conclusion_scope: Applies to standalone H&E subtype prediction in TCGA-BRCA patients using these five frozen encoders; does not establish incremental gain over clinical variables, biological mechanism, or external clinical utility.
notes: Per D5, clinical and receptor variables are forbidden because the question asks what H&E alone predicts, overriding the incremental-value template; use fold-internal class weighting inside repeated nested patient CV.
